sample.question:
The synchronized front, right, and top panels show labeled beacons in a 6x6x6 coordinate cube. Coordinates are (x,y,z), each from 0 to 5. Rotation Z+ maps (x,y,z) to (5-y,x,z); rotation X+ maps it to (x,5-z,y).
Using only Z+ and X+, what is the minimum number of rotations needed to move beacon B to (3, 4, 4)?
A. 4
B. 5
C. 0
D. 1
E. 2
F. 3
sample.analysis: Breadth-first search on beacon B's rotation orbit finds ['Z+', 'X+', 'Z+', 'Z+', 'Z+'] with length 5. No state at smaller depth reaches (3, 4, 4). The answer is B.
